name: War Inc: Rising Best Synergies Guide — Team Bonus Effects
title: War Inc: Rising Best Synergies Guide — Max Your Team Bonuses
meta_description: Complete guide to War Inc: Rising synergies. Learn all 9 synergy effects, how to activate team bonuses, best hero combinations for each synergy, and which synergies dominate the meta.
author: Klown Kollege

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.content:
Synergies are team-wide bonuses triggered by fielding heroes with matching attributes. Build to activate 2-3 synergy types rather than spreading thin across all 9. A focused strategy outperforms a spread-out one every time.

Here's what synergies do, which ones matter most, and how to build around them.

sections.heading: What Synergies Are and Why They Matter
sections.content:
When you field multiple heroes sharing certain attributes, you unlock synergy bonuses. These can be damage increases, damage reduction, speed boosts, or unique combat mechanics.

More heroes of the matching type unlocks higher synergy tiers. The bonuses stack, so 3 Assassins is better than 2.

Synergies separate good teams from great ones. Two teams with the same heroes but different synergy activation will perform differently.

sections.heading: How to Build Around Synergies
sections.content:
Pick 2-3 synergy types and commit. Trying to activate 5 synergies means none of them are strong enough to matter.

Example: Pairing multiple Assassins triggers burst damage bonuses that make them even more lethal. A team of 4-5 Assassins with synergy active outperforms a mixed team of 5 different professions.

Use the synergy guides on each hero page to check which synergies a hero belongs to before building your team.

sections.heading: Best Meta Synergy Combinations
sections.content:
Current meta favorites:
- Water-element teams: Frost Queen + Tide Lord + other water units. Excellent control and damage.
- Light-element teams: Light Seeker + Radiant Warrior + support. Great balance of offense and defense.
- Profession-based: All Tanks or all Mages. Straightforward bonuses that are easy to build around.
- Assassin stacks: Burst damage focused. Risky but devastating when it works.

Experiment with different combinations. The best synergy setup depends on which heroes you have available.
